headline: INDIA-MYANMAR RARE EARTH FORUM: 200 DELEGATES, 6 INDIAN FIRMS — Bilateral Push Targets China's Heavy REE Stranglehold
snippet: India and Myanmar held a landmark bilateral rare earth forum on July 24, drawing 200+ participants including 6 Indian companies and 9 Myanmar mining and business associations, deepening ties on extraction and processing amid China's ongoing controls on seven heavy REEs. Myanmar supplies roughly half the world's heavy rare earths — historically routed entirely through China for separation — making India-Myanmar cooperation a strategically significant supply-chain bypass as New Delhi pushes to end its near-total dependency on Beijing-controlled processing.

headline: GOLD MINERS Q2: AGNICO +53% EPS, KINROSS +52% — Iran Oil Costs Could Bite; AEM Reports July 29, Newmont Thursday
snippet: Reuters reports gold miners are set for sharply higher Q2 profits as average gold prices climbed 37% year-on-year to $4,506/oz in Q2 2026 — Agnico Eagle projected at $2.98 EPS (+53.6% YoY, reports July 29) and Kinross at $0.67 (+52.3%, also July 29), with Barrick following August 10. RBC analyst Josh Wolfson says producers are 'in a position of strength' with net cash and strong free cash flow, though Iran-driven energy cost inflation could temper headline earnings growth — and Scotiabank forecasts sizeable buybacks from all four majors through H2.

headline: LARAMIDE WESTMORELAND: $741M NPV, 33% IRR AT $90/LB — 5M LB/YR Australia Uranium; Lease App Ready (TSX: LAM)
snippet: Laramide Resources Ltd. (TSX/ASX: LAM) released an updated Preliminary Economic Assessment on July 22 for its Westmoreland Uranium Project in Queensland, Australia — delivering a post-tax NPV of US$741.1 million at 7.5% discount, a 33% post-tax IRR, and a 2.5-year payback at US$90/lb U₃O₈. The project profiles average annual production approaching 5 million pounds of uranium oxide over the mine life, and Laramide is now positioned to lodge a Mining Lease Application with the Queensland Government — one of the largest uranium development projects in Australia advancing as contract prices hit 14-year highs.

headline: SECTION 232 REPORT DUE THIS MONTH — 3 URANIUM STOCKS TO BUY NOW; Cameco Q2 July 31 As Second Catalyst
snippet: A July 23 analysis identifies uranium stocks best positioned for two imminent catalysts: the Section 232 status report due this month — which could impose domestic-sourcing rules and reprice uranium as a strategic asset — and Cameco's Q2 earnings on July 31. With uranium holding above $85/lb, 38 countries pledged to triple nuclear by 2050, and hyperscalers signing AI data center nuclear power agreements, domestic-focused producers like Uranium Energy Corp and Centrus get the sharpest re-rating if Section 232 lands with teeth, while Cameco remains the lower-beta way to own the theme.

headline: TALAMORE COFFEE GOLD: 42.4m AT 1.50 g/t AND 8.4m AT 5.37 g/t Au — Supremo Extension Yukon Infill Confirms Grade (TSXV: TALA)
snippet: Talamore Mining Corporation (TSXV: TALA) released July 22 assay results from 55 holes at the Supremo Extension of its Coffee Gold Project in Yukon — best results including 42.4 metres at 1.50 g/t Au in hole 26-SPX-RC100 and 8.4 metres at 5.37 g/t Au in hole 26-SPX-RC084, advancing infill drilling on a resource currently standing at 2,437 kt indicated at 1.18 g/t and 6,059 kt inferred at 1.72 g/t gold. The 40,000-metre 2026 program continues tightening spacing on the Supremo envelope, building the grade confidence needed for a resource update at one of the Yukon's active open-pit development targets.

headline: DISCOVERY MINING PAMOUR: 17.36 g/t OVER 5.9m + BULK 30m ZONES VALIDATED — 3.7 Moz Confirmed, Stock +8.1% (TSX: DSV)
snippet: Discovery Mining Ltd. (TSX: DSV) released July 21 results from 47 holes totalling 11,003 metres at the Pamour Mine near Timmins, Ontario — confirming a large-scale deposit with highlights including 17.36 g/t Au over 5.9 metres on the Keora Trend, 3.05 g/t over 30.0 metres and 2.13 g/t over 31.1 metres in the central pit, and 11.54 g/t over 5.1 metres at Pamour West. The results validate and expand the existing 3.7 Moz open-pit resource (64.8 Mt at 1.30 g/t indicated + 23.3 Mt at 1.34 g/t inferred) while pushing DSV shares up 8.1% — one of the larger single-session moves in Ontario bulk-tonnage gold explorers this year.

headline: CABRAL GOLD MG: 70% BUILT, Q4 2026 PRODUCTION ON TRACK — 165-Hole Infill Locks In Oxide Reserve in Brazil (TSXV: CBR)
snippet: Cabral Gold Inc. (TSXV: CBR) announced July 21 completion of 41 additional reverse-circulation infill holes at the MG Gold Deposit in Brazil's Cuiú Cuiú district — bringing the pre-production infill program to 165 holes and 5,767 metres with best results including 17 metres at 1.93 g/t Au with 1 metre at 15.91 g/t. Phase 1 heap-leach construction is now 70% complete, with commercial gold-in-oxide production targeted Q4 2026 — making Cabral one of the few sub-$100M market-cap developers on the verge of first gold production this year at a fully permitted Brazilian asset.

headline: ATLAS MINERALS GRAPHITE BRAZIL: 20/20 HOLES HIT — 33.78m AT 7.97% Cg; MRE Due Q4 2026 in Minas Gerais
snippet: Atlas Critical Minerals Corporation reported July 21 that all 20 holes in its maiden 2,300-metre diamond program at the 100%-owned Graphite Project in Minas Gerais, Brazil confirmed high-grade mineralization — the best intercept returning 33.78 metres at 7.97% graphitic carbon, with continuity confirmed both along strike and at depth, and SGS retained to deliver a Maiden Mineral Resource Estimate in Q4 2026. Natural graphite is a critical battery anode material with over 95% of global processing currently in China, making a confirmed high-grade Brazilian graphite asset a strategically relevant early-stage project as automakers and battery makers push to build non-Chinese supply chains.

headline: SCOTTIE RESOURCES: 10,000m DOWN, 7 RIGS TURNING — 50,000m Golden Triangle FS Campaign 20% Complete (TSXV: SCOT)
snippet: Scottie Resources Corp. (TSXV: SCOT) reported July 23 it has drilled over 10,000 metres in 47 holes — 20% of its fully financed 50,000-metre 2026 program at the Scottie Gold Mine Project in BC's Golden Triangle, 35 kilometres north of Stewart, with 7 rigs active targeting the Blueberry Contact Zone, Serac Vein, Domino target, and other high-priority areas. With assay results pending on all 47 holes, the program remains on track for a Feasibility Study with an updated Mineral Resource Estimate in H1 2027 — the most active single-project drill campaign currently running in BC's Golden Triangle.

headline: PUMA EXPLORATION: 42 g/t Au VEINS AT McKENZIE — Inaugural Drill Hits High-Grade System in New Brunswick (TSXV: PUMA)
snippet: Puma Exploration Inc. (TSXV: PUMA) announced July 21 results from its inaugural 2,721-metre diamond program at the RIM Gold Zone of the McKenzie Gold Project in Northern New Brunswick — intersecting high-grade gold in quartz vein structures including 42.60 g/t Au over 0.25 metres, 21.86 g/t Au over 0.30 metres, and 13.41 g/t Au over 0.25 metres, hosted within a broader 5-to-20-metre low-grade envelope. Results confirm the presence of a high-grade orogenic gold system in a historically overlooked district, with follow-up drill targets to be defined from this summer's ongoing surface exploration program.
